messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PAGER p-9876 -> HIGH severity: serving runtime errors (us-west1). Alert: multiple CUDA OOMs + container restarts detected. Paging @oncall-sre and eng-runtime. https://pagerduty.example/p/9876 :rotating_light:

tara: I’m on it. Seeing a spike in 5xxs and restarts for the real-time serving pool in us-west1. Any immediate customer reports?

aj: quick triage — logs show RDMA retransmits and IB path probe timeouts correlating with the first OOMs. grabbing dmesg + ib stats now.

aj: ```
[ 12345.678901] mlx5_core 0000:01:00.0: Link is down
[ 12346.001234] mlx5_core 0000:01:00.0: link_flap_detected: port 1
[ 12346.100542] rdma: IB QP timeout, rc -> retransmit
[ 12346.200789] nvidia: GPU 0: Out of memory. Killing process 14822 (serve-runtime)
[ 12346.200793] container restart: serve-runtime-pod-rt-12
```

lukas: Customer impact: alpha-co and beta-co are showing elevated latency and intermittent 502s between 13:02-13:10 UTC. We redirected some traffic to CPU fallback but not all requests are covered.

maria: Initiating partial fallback routing for latency-sensitive routes to reduce GPU pressure. Command I used: `redwood route update --cluster us-west1 --route /v1/generate --fallback-model rwd-fallback-cpu-v1 --percent 40`

aj: ibstat + ethtool extracts for affected host rt-serve-12:

```
# ibstat -s rt-serve-12
port 1: state 4 (ACTIVE)
port counters: rx_drops=12456 tx_drops=980 rx_errors=780
link_speed: 100Gb
# ethtool -S mlx5_core
port1_pkt_err=732
port1_link_flap=7
```

aj: that 12% drop rate on rx_drops correlates with RDMA reorder/timeouts. When the RDMA layer retransmits heavily we are seeing KV cache rebuild storms across replicas which spike GPU memory usage leading to OOMs.

tara: Taking rt-serve-17 out of rotation (cordon + drain) to stop noisy node from impacting the pool. `kubectl cordon rt-serve-17 && kubectl drain rt-serve-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

aj: restarted the pod on rt-serve-12 after cordon. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/serve-runtime -n production` — watching metrics.

sre-bot: WARNING: GPU memory util > 90% on remaining hosts in us-west1 (serve-pool). Avoid launching heavy eval jobs. :warning:

oncall-sre: I’ll take over. Handoff notes: isolate flapping nodes (rt-serve-12, rt-serve-17), maintain fallback routing, prioritize customer-facing routes for CPU fallback. Escalating to infra for switch-level checks (INFRA-4563). I will own incident for next 4h.

cs-rep: Notified alpha-co & beta-co with templated message. They asked for ETA and mitigation steps; told them minimal service degraded but fallback is active. Will provide status update in 20m.

lukas: hypothesis summary for postmortem: ECN/queueing on the IB fabric -> increased retransmits / reorder -> RDMA timeouts -> excessive KV cache invalidation across replicas -> bursty memory allocations on GPUs -> CUDA OOM -> container restarts. Need switch counters, port reset history, and driver logs.

maria: Added automated canary fallback mix to reduce blast radius: `redwood rollout create --name ib-pktloss-fallback --cluster us-west1 --policy fallback-30pct --duration 15m`

aj: sharing nvidia-smi snapshot from affected host (rt-serve-12) showing OOM churn:

```
Timestamp: 2025-09-02T13:05:34Z
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.54       Driver Version: 535.54       CUDA Version: 12.2    |
| Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap  Memory-Usage                                 |
|  40%   78C  P2    280W / 350W    15800MiB / 16384MiB                        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  PID   Type   Name                  GPU Memory                                |
| 14822  C      serve-runtime         15300MiB                                   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

oncall-sre: Action items (assigned):
- oncall-sre: maintain fallback routes + continue customer comms (owner)
- infra: inspect switch ports for us-west1 leaf A,B, collect counters & check for ECN-marked packets (INFRA-4563, P0)
- eng-runtime (@aj, @tara): cordon noisy nodes, patch kvcache rebuild backoff if needed, throttle cross-node cache syncs
- cs-rep: update customers every 20m

oncall-sre: Handoff summary posted to #incidents. If infra confirms fabric instability we will keep fallback in place and start rolling nodes through maintenance. tagging @infra.

maria: Will keep an eye on canary percentages and increase fallback if we see more OOMs.

aj: adding logs to ticket INFRA-4563 and attaching per-port counters + dmesg loop.

oncall-sre: Last update before handoff to night oncall (in 2h): all noisy nodes cordoned/drained, fallback at 40%, customer comms ongoing, infra engaged. Next update at +20m or on big state change.

cs-rep: alpha-co acknowledged; they want a postmortem once root cause confirmed.

-- end of thread --
